title: Read a body into a struct
summary: Fiber: Read a body into a struct. Send an empty object.
introduction: BodyParser fills a struct from the request body. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a body into a struct with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.
Read a body into a struct

blocks.title: Read a body into a struct

blocks.text: BodyParser fills the struct by pointer. The nonempty Title check succeeds before the 201 reply.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Parsing does not replace checks for a useful field value.
